fields.title: JSON column
fields.description: Name of the JSON column to expand.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: Remove source column
fields.description: When checked, the input JSON column is removed.

fields.title: Expand to
fields.description: Select which parts of the JSON structure to extract.

fields.title: Maximum depth level
fields.description: The columns are generated only for paths with length up to this value (inclusive, starting from 1).

fields.title: Column names from
fields.description: Select how to generate output column names from the JSON structure.

fields.title: Path separator
fields.description: Separator used to split the path into segments.

fields.title: Arrays as
fields.description: Choose how to handle JSON arrays in the input data.

fields.title: Omit nested objects
fields.description:
Nested objects in arrays are not included in the output when checked (except when the output column is a JSON column). This is sometimes desirable as sub-objects are extracted into separate levels. Consider an example input table with the following JSON rows: 
  • {
 "Array object":
   [1, 2, 3]
}
  • {
 "Array object":
   [4, {"Nested object": 5}]
}
If you set the expansion level to 1, extract the column names from the leaf names, and process arrays as collections, column Array object will contain
  • [1,2,3], [4]
    if "Omit nested objects" is selected
  • [1,2,3],
    [4, {"Nested object": 5}]
    if "Omit nested objects" is not selected
